results.text: Aripiprazole: 6-month outcomes in a retrospective naturalistic study. Aim. The efficacy of aripiprazole has been demonstrated in randomised controlled trials, but due to inclusion and exclusion criteria, these may not be representative of clinical practice. The aim of this naturalistic study was to investigate patients from an acute mental health trust who received aripiprazole, using treatment discontinuation as a primary outcome measure. Method. All patients with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder

results.text: Efficacy and safety of tegoprazan (LXI-15028) vs. esomeprazole in patients with erosive esophagitis: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind, non-inferiority phase Ⅲ trial. An evidence gap still exists regarding the efficacy and safety of tegoprazan in Chinese patients with erosive esophagitis (EE) in China. This study aimed to verify the efficacy and safety of tegoprazan vs. esomeprazole in patients with EE in China. A Multinational Randomized Trial of Mega-Dose Esomeprazole as Anti-Inflammatory Agent in Sepsis. Proton pump inhibitors have dose-dependent immunomodulatory effects. We tested the hypothesis that mega-dose esomeprazole therapy would reduce organ dysfunction in patients with sepsis or septic shock. A multinational, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial. Seventeen ICUs or emergency departments in three countries. Adult patients with sepsis or septic shock.
